description: quote_generation returns the current price or reports that the total is unknown. The server submits only with max_credits at or above the current quote, or with accept_unknown_cost:true when no total can be quoted. Agents charge per stage; no whole-run spending cap is enforced. Supply the intended tool and its planned input parameters. Reads current Freebeat pricing rules, without starting or charging for generation. Quoted credits are list price before account discounts or allowances. Unavailable means unknown, never free; agent totals depend on stages and retries. For music, check list_music_models for length control before quoting.

parameters.description: The same input parameters planned for the paid tool, including the model, prompt, duration, and other price-changing options.

name: quote_generation

outputSchema.description: On success, returns the tool result fields. On error, returns success:false, error and code, with optional credit approval details; success-only fields are absent.
